title: 第5章 这剧情不听我使唤啊！
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

编辑白云虽然不知道田小西为什么想要新的账号，但是不妨碍他帮她走流程注销了老账号。

【白云：你小号挂靠现在账号就是，没必要还走解约流程注销老账号吧？】

走解约流程注销老账号，然后又用新账号签约，这不是有病吗？

可对方显然很坚决。

还发过来一句。

【田小西：这是我对他们彻底告别的仪式感！】

【田小西：这是伟大又盛大的埋葬！是他们的命运！】

【编辑白云：……】

【编辑白云：好了，你看看吧。】

算了，反正她的作品都扑街断更，老账号解约就解约吧。

“新的账号！”

“新的人生！”

田小西仪式感十分足的坐在椅子上拜了拜，像是超度老账号一般，一脸虔诚。

“老账号已暴死！”

“这个该死的枪手总不能追到我小号来了吧！”

怀揣着兴奋的心情，她点开了新的漫画作家账号，啊！干净的账号一如她干净的…嗯？

兴奋还没褪去，当她看到那熟悉的《妖怪都市》，熟悉的对话框时，整个人都呆滞了。

“！！！！！”

【请输入剧情：+】

【注：《妖怪都市》里的设定已成型，只能细化设定，以文字的形式输入剧情，有可能会失败，如果失败，失败原因请自行摸索。】

这是怎么回事？

这个枪手难道是网站内部人员吗？是不是脑子有病！？

好！好！好！

虽然不知道谁是那个懂黑客技术脑子又有病的枪手！

你激怒我了！

“输入剧情是吧！”

“我这给你们来一坨命运馈赠！”

不然这个枪手还不知道她的实力！

田小西盘腿坐在椅子上，带着愤怒的输入了一段剧情：【晚上，江黛因为肚子饿流落街头，遇到了入门级的妖魔骨面犬。

因为肚子饥饿，被骨面犬打伤奄奄一息变回原形，在街角遇到了深夜还在小区外边逛的路安！】

对抗妖魔组队群像的核心伙伴相遇！相遇了才能后续遇到其他主角团！陆续集结！

在这后边因为输入剧情的缘故，没法画画，田小西还特地在后边加了一段长长的描述。

【战损版江黛，虽然穿着校服但是不能掩盖她的绝色容貌，脸上不能沾有泥土，狼狈中透着破碎感，衣服上满是战斗后的猩红血迹…】

小猫的原本战力打不打得过骨面犬？

这不重要！

为了剧情！它在这里必须打不过！打过了还怎么组队？

对抗妖魔的群像小队还怎么集结！这剧情应该不会不听使唤吧？

不知为什么。

田小西心底有种不祥的预感。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Although editor Bai Yun didn't know why Tian Xiaoxi wanted a new account, it didn't stop him from helping her go through the process of canceling her old account.

[Baiyun: Your trumpet is linked to your current account. There is no need to go through the contract termination process to cancel the old account, right?】

Isn’t it unhealthy to go through the contract termination process to cancel the old account and then sign the contract with a new account?

But the other party was obviously very determined.

I also sent a sentence.

[Tian Xiaoxi: This is my final farewell to them!】

[Tian Xiaoxi: This is a great and grand burial!It's their destiny!】

[Editor Baiyun:...]

[Editor Baiyun: Okay, let’s take a look.】

Forget it, her works have all been discontinued anyway, so if the old account is terminated, just terminate the contract.

"New account!"

"New life!"

Tian Xiaoxi sat down on the chair and bowed in a very ceremonial manner, as if he was paying homage to an old account, with a pious look on his face.

"The old account has died violently!"

"This damn gunman can't catch my trumpet!"

With excitement, she clicked on the new comic book writer account, ah!A clean account is as clean as her... huh?

The excitement hadn't faded yet. When she saw the familiar "Monster City" and the familiar dialog box, her whole body froze.

“!!!!!!”

[Please enter the plot: +]

[Note: The settings in "Monster City" have already been taken shape. You can only refine the settings and input the plot in the form of text. It may fail. If it fails, please find out the reason for the failure by yourself.】

What's going on?

Is this shooter an insider of the website?Is there something wrong with your brain??

good!good!good!

Although I don’t know who is the gunman who knows hacking skills and is mentally ill!

You pissed me off!

"Enter the plot, right?"

"I'll give you a gift from fate!"

Otherwise, this gunman wouldn't know her strength!

Tian Xiaoxi sat cross-legged on a chair and entered a plot angrily: [At night, Jiang Dai wandered on the street because she was hungry and met the entry-level demon bone-faced dog.

Because he was hungry, he was injured by a bone-faced dog and was about to return to his original shape. At the street corner, he met Lu An who was still wandering outside the community late at night!】

Meet the core partners of the team that fights monsters!Only after you meet can you meet other protagonist groups later!Collecting one after another!

Because I couldn't draw a picture because of the input of the plot, Tian Xiaoxi specially added a long description at the end.

[The battle-damaged version of Jiang Dai, although she is wearing a school uniform, her stunning appearance cannot be concealed. There must be no dirt on her face. There is a sense of brokenness in her embarrassment, and her clothes are covered with scarlet bloodstains after the battle...]

Can the original fighting strength of the kitten be better than that of the bone-faced dog?

It's not important!

For the sake of plot!It has to be beat here!How to form a team after fighting?

How to assemble the team to fight against the monsters!This plot shouldn't be out of control, right?

Don't know why.

Tian Xiaoxi had an ominous premonition in her heart.
